svg.text: Current VI's Path then Strip Path TWICE: the first strip removes the VI name, the second removes the lib folder. Build Path then adds data\limits.csv.
That is why the station still runs after you move the folder. A hard-coded C:\... path is the single most common reason a LabVIEW project breaks on another machine.
limits ok? is Build Array of the four found? booleans through And Array Elements. If one row is missing from the CSV the LED goes dark and the sequencer refuses to test.
